title: Contractor Progress vs Schedule
dataSources: Renovation tasks (`reno:task`), budget and receipts (`reno:budget`), material orders (`reno:material`), inspections (`reno:inspection`), contractor logs (`reno:contractor`).
app: Home-renovation project management — task boards (Trello, Notion), budget and receipt trackers, material orders, and inspection / permit logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reno:task
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(eval(if(status="done",1,0))) as done, count as total by _time
| eval completion_pct=round(100*done/total,1)
| sort _time
description: Trends the share of planned tasks completed each week so you can tell whether the job is on schedule.
value: A weekly completion trend reveals slippage while there is still time to add hands or adjust the plan.
implementation: Ingest task completions into `index=personal`; trend weekly completion.
visualization: Line chart of weekly task completion percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how much of the work gets finished each week, so you know if the build is running to time.
